package.name: diy_waypoint_sequencer
package.description:
Standalone, optional automated goal sequencer for the custom A* + PD/ pure-pursuit navigation stack (planning / motion_planner) and, via the use_nav2_action parameter, for Nav2's bt_navigator too. Default mode publishes /goal_pose in sequence from a simple waypoints YAML, advancing on /pd/goal_reached — deliberately has ZERO dependency on zone_nav in that mode; if this node isn't run, /goal_pose can still be published manually (RViz "2D Goal Pose", or ros2 topic pub) with no code changes anywhere else in the stack. See docs/reuse_plan_step1.md for the design rationale. use_nav2_action:=true instead drives nav2_msgs/action/NavigateToPose directly and advances on that action's terminal GoalStatus.
Also hosts waypoint_recorder_node, a companion tool for the reverse direction: recording a waypoints YAML live during an offline mapping drive, using the joystick's LT/RT triggers, instead of picking points after the fact from a finished map (see pick_waypoints.py).
